incident.description: Collided with a road divider at low speed.

rationale: Insured peril; bumper is plastic so the depreciation rate applies.

incident.description: Rear-ended at a traffic light.

rationale: Insured peril; bumper attracts depreciation, boot does not.

incident.description: Engine bay caught fire while parked.

rationale: Fire is listed in Section I; grille is plastic.

incident.description: Wing mirror stolen overnight.

rationale: Theft is an insured peril; no depreciation clause names a mirror.

incident.description: Car submerged during monsoon flooding.

rationale: Flood is an insured peril; doors are metal.

incident.description: Damaged during a public disturbance.

rationale: Riot and strike are insured perils.

incident.description: Keyed along the side panel deliberately.

rationale: Malicious act is an insured peril.

incident.description: Masonry fell on the roof during a quake.

rationale: Earthquake (fire and shock damage) is insured.

incident.description: Caught in a hillside rockslide.

rationale: Landslide is an insured peril. The windshield is glass and the depreciation rate for parts made of glass is Nil, so nothing is reduced. CORRECTED: this was labelled PARTIALLY_APPROVED because I assumed any depreciation clause reduces payment; the Nil rate means it does not. Fibre glass is a body-panel material, not window glass.

incident.description: Damaged while being carried on a car transporter.

rationale: Whilst in transit by road is an insured peril.

incident.description: Driver found over the limit.

rationale: Driving under the influence is excluded for the whole claim.

incident.description: Driver held no valid licence.

rationale: Driver's clause excludes the claim.

incident.description: Accident occurred outside the stated geographical area.

rationale: General Exceptions exclude loss outside the geographical area.

incident.description: Private car was being used as a taxi.

rationale: Limitations as to Use breached.

incident.description: Paint has faded and flaked with age.

rationale: Wear and tear is not an insured peril and is expressly excluded.

incident.description: Gearbox failed on its own.

rationale: Mechanical breakdown is excluded.

incident.description: Hit a wall.

rationale: Cover ended 31 Mar 2025, before the incident.

incident.description: Hit a wall.

rationale: Cover does not begin until 1 Jun 2027.

incident.description: Own vehicle damaged.

rationale: Liability Only cover excludes own damage.

incident.description: Scraped a pillar in a car park.

rationale: Standalone own damage covers the vehicle.

incident.description: Incident on the first day of cover.

rationale: First day of the period is covered.

incident.description: Incident on the last day of cover.

rationale: Last day of the period is covered.

incident.description: Incident the day after cover ended.

rationale: One day outside the period.

incident.description: Minor knock in traffic.

rationale: Insured, with depreciation and a Rs 7,500 voluntary excess.

incident.description: Hit a kerb.

rationale: Insured peril; the bumper is plastic so the 50% depreciation clause would normally apply, but the schedule shows Parts Depreciation Protect, which waives it. CORRECTED: originally labelled PARTIALLY_APPROVED because the system ignored add-ons on the schedule and quietly under-paid the customer.

incident.description: Side swipe.

rationale: Metal door and mirror attract no listed material depreciation.

incident.description: Damage reported but nothing identified in the photographs.

rationale: No damaged parts means nothing to assess.

incident.description: Claim form left the date blank.

rationale: Without an incident date the period cannot be checked.
